flashcard_questions.q: The UK body responsible for regulating advertising across all media, ensuring adverts are legal, decent, honest and truthful. It investigates complaints and can require misleading adverts to be withdrawn.
The UK regulatory body for broadcasting, telecoms and postal services. It sets standards for TV and radio content, investigates complaints, and ensures fair competition in communications markets.
The independent body responsible for classifying films and cinema trailers in the UK using age ratings (U, PG, 12A, 12, 15, 18) to indicate content suitability for different audiences.

flashcard_questions.a: A European rating system for video games that uses age recommendations (3, 7, 12, 16, 18) and content descriptors to help consumers make informed choices about which games are appropriate.
flashcard_questions.q: What is meant by 'PEGI (Pan European Game Information)'?

flashcard_questions.a: A pre-production visit to a potential filming location to assess its suitability, identify potential hazards, check for noise issues, assess lighting conditions, and confirm access and parking arrangements.
